_comment: TEMPLATE for the Robinhood MAINNET cutover — NOT live. Do NOT fill this by hand: run `./scripts/deploy-mainnet-rh.sh --stage manifest`, which copies this over round.json, fills it from the broadcast artifacts, and REFUSES to ship while any <FILL> survives. Keep `schema` a NEW value so Ponder does a clean reindex on the new chain. poolManager/positionManager are the Uniswap v4 deployments on chain 4663 — both VERIFIED to carry code via eth_getCode on 2026-09-16.

_producers._note: WHICH TOOL FILLS WHAT. Six keys had NO producer and were carried forward by hand on every round; that is how a Sepolia chainId could survive a mainnet cutover. scripts/deploy-mainnet-rh.sh --stage manifest now fills all six and refuses to ship on any survivor.
_producers.contracts.*: scripts/apply-deployment.mjs --chain 4663, from contracts/solidity/broadcast/*/4663/run-latest.json. hook/seeder/collection/poolIds are resolved by eth_call — it needs RPC_URL set to a 4663 endpoint or it silently asks Sepolia (apply-deployment.mjs:251,278,294,313).
_producers.chainId: deploy-mainnet-rh.sh (constant 4663). NO producer before — it stayed 11155111 through a mainnet cutover unless hand-edited.
_producers.genesisSupply: deploy-mainnet-rh.sh, read from presale.GENESIS_SUPPLY() on chain.
_producers.deathThresholdEth: deploy-mainnet-rh.sh, read from hook.deathThreshold() on chain. UNITS TRAP: with no oracle wired this is native wei; once an oracle is wired CauldronHook._toUsd re-denominates every volume figure and it becomes USD at 1e18 (CauldronHook.sol:1929-1947). The frontend labels it 'Ξ' either way (TheCauldron.tsx:878,1016). It is only a pre-indexer fallback — the live value comes from the indexer (useCauldronMachine.ts:241) — and 0 renders as 100% vitality.
_producers.legacyBps, legacyThresholdEth: deploy-mainnet-rh.sh, MIRRORED from the LEGACY_BPS / LEGACY_THRESHOLD deploy env (DeployLaunchpad.s.sol:429-430). They CANNOT be read back: CauldronHook.legacyBps and .legacyThreshold are `internal` (CauldronHook.sol:332,336), so there is no getter. If you deploy with non-default values you must pass the same values to the manifest stage.
_producers.indexerUrl: NOT DERIVABLE. Railway assigns the hostname when the indexer is deployed, which happens after the contracts. Supply INDEXER_URL=... to the manifest stage; it refuses to run without it.
_producers.quoteAssets: By hand, per quote governance approves. The mainnet deploy runs DEPLOY_QUOTES=false, so no MockQuoteToken exists (its mint() is ungated — MockQuoteToken.sol:27) and ETH is the only entry.

blocks._note: deploy = CauldronRegistry deploy block; perp = PerpEngine deploy block; indexer = a few blocks before the first summon (bounds getLogs). Fill from broadcast logs.

poolIds: <FILL: gen-1 poolId from the summon tx>
_quoteAssetsNote: REQUIRED, not optional. The app reads the LIVE generation's quote ADDRESS from the registry on-chain; this list is where its decimals/symbol come from. An entry missing here used to fall back to 18 decimals, which signs a sell floor 10^(18-d) too large on any non-18-decimal quote. Decimals are now also read on-chain (useQuoteDecimals) and the trade panel refuses to sign until they resolve — but an unlisted quote still renders as a bare address. Add every quote governance will approve.

quoteAssets.name: Ether
quoteAssets.blurb: The default. Deepest liquidity, and the only pair perps support today.
